test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

We think __of the history __of the world __as fixed__ but of the future __as undecided__ and open to a __wealth off__ possibilities.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase "wealth off" is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be "wealth of".
 
• The preposition "of" is used to** indicate possession**,** origin**, or** association**, and is the correct usage in this context.
 
• The incorrect usage "off" is typically used to indicate separation or disconnection and does not fit in this context.

Hence, the correct statement is '***We think of the past history of the world as fixed but of the future as undecided and open to a wealth of __possibilities*.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• It is important to understand the correct usage of prepositions in sentences to ensure** clarity and correctness.**
 
• Common prepositions include "of", "to", "in", "on", "at", "by", etc.
 
• **Incorrect **usage of prepositions can lead to confusion and grammatical errors in writing.
